prereg.note: Mean floors match PR #12/#14. science_open never self-stamped; PASS_CANDIDATE_FOR_OPEN still leaves science_open=false.
prereg.selection_rule: Before any matched-OOD floors look: best ckpt = argmax ((1/3)*HN_id+(1/3)*K16_select_longhop+(1/3)*overall_id @ T16, min(HN,K16), overall, -epoch). HN_weight=1/3 ≤0.5 (no HN overweight; V2 0.7 forbidden). K16 from data/id_select_longhop.jsonl (selection-only aux; matched seq_len band; disjoint from floors set after overlap filter). Floors evaluated only on matched-OOD after train. If ≥4/5 → PASS_CANDIDATE_FOR_OPEN only; no auto-widen.
